title: Sword World SFC 2 - Inishie no Kyojin Densetsu
aliases: Sword World SFC 2: Inishie no Kyojin Densetsu
description: A Super Famicom RPG based on a Japanese table-top game. It is the sequel to the original SFC Sword World and offers more questing for the player's customizable adventurers.
